findings.resolution: Added runtime-version-registry; legacy 1-design labels no longer authorize production result versions.
Added exact bulk read method IDs per process and repository-contract registry.
Query count is cardinality-independent; point lookup inside member loops is forbidden and query-plan evidence required.
Added per-process performance registry freezing complexity/workload/strategy and critical hard bounds.
Pure kernels are forbidden from DB/UI/platform access; resolver owns immutable input assembly.
Medium/large UI execution forbidden; canonical final ordering and worker-order independence are machine rules.
Added stable finding-code registry and per-process namespaces.
Trace prefixes are frozen for all 27 processes and validated against dossier section-17 equation codes.
Exact 16 operation-to-handler/protocol bindings are machine-owned and checked against command-registry.json.
